question: Will Agamemnon be on operations by 2027, yes or no?

lines.text: HMS Agamemnon, Britain's newest hunter-killer submarine, has arrived at Faslane.
She's the sixth Astute-class boat, and her keel was laid in July 2013.

scene.label: years since her keel was laid

lines.text: Navy Lookout says the Ministry of Defence once expected her in service by 2022.
lines.note: Navy Lookout: MoD said in 2013 she would enter service in 2022

lines.text: She left the BAE Systems yard in Barrow on 25 September.
On the way, she made her first ever dive at sea, off the Inner Hebrides.
lines.note: Royal Navy: first dive at sea, Inner Hebrides Exercise Areas

lines.text: Her commander, John Gabb, says she's incredibly quiet, with world-class sonar.

scene.quote: this submarine is incredibly quiet, has a world-class Sonar

lines.text: Astute boats carry Tomahawk missiles and Spearfish torpedoes, and can sail round the world submerged.
lines.note: Royal Navy: Tomahawk, Spearfish, circumnavigate submerged

lines.text: She arrived 125 years to the day after the Navy's first submarine, Holland 1, was launched.
Now come months of sea trials with a crew of about 100.
lines.note: Royal Navy: trials over coming weeks and months; crew around 100

lines.text: Navy Lookout expects her to be fully operational in late 2027.
Last week it said no Astute boat had been on operations since May.
lines.note: Navy Lookout (about 25 Sep): HMS Anson alongside since 27 May

lines.text: The seventh and final boat, HMS Achilles, is still being built in Barrow.
Six built, one to go. Will Agamemnon be on operations by 2027, yes or no?
